plain_english_revision: This amendment carves out an exception for healthcare providers and hospitals from the bill’s general ban on vaccine passports. It removes a word that would have broadened the prohibition to include Medicaid eligibility, then explicitly exempts doctors, dentists, medical institutions, and hospitals from the law’s scope.
candidate_position_supported: Exempting healthcare providers from vaccine passport restrictions in Medicaid eligibility determinations
evidence_quotes: to exclude certain health care providers
<-- removes a blanket prohibition for all entities, including Medicaid
This act shall not apply to physicians, surgeons, dentists, medical institutions, or other health care providers...
review_reason: The amendment text is clear and self-contained; no external context needed.
